brand.name: RoadwiseFleet
app.title: Fleet Manager — RoadwiseFleet
login.title: Sign in to Fleet Manager
login.lead: Use your RoadwiseFleet account. Dispatchers, accountants and drivers all sign in here.
login.helper: Accounts are created by your fleet owner — there is no self-service signup.
overview.title: Overview
overview.body: You are signed in to the Fleet Manager shell. The dashboard KPIs, trips list and dispatch tools plug into this layout as each function lands.
overview.roleNav: Your navigation is limited to what your role may do.
dashboard.lead: Today at a glance — every number is computed from your company's own data.
dashboard.driverTitle: Your day is on My trips
dashboard.driverBody: The dashboard is for dispatchers, accountants and the owner. Your assigned trips, statuses and document capture are on My trips.
dashboard.loadFailed: Could not load the dashboard. Try again.
dispatch.lead: Create a trip from your company's orders — pick an order, then a driver and a truck. There are no IDs to type.
dispatch.customerHint: This comes from the order; choose a different order to change it.
dispatch.rateHint: Optional. A non-negative amount; leave it empty if the rate is agreed later.
dispatch.draftNote: The trip is created as a draft.
dispatch.loadFailed: Could not load the orders, drivers and trucks. Try again.
dispatch.noOrders: There are no orders yet. Add an order first, then dispatch it.
dispatch.fixErrors: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
dispatch.error.orderUnknown: That order is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.driverUnknown: That driver is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.truckUnknown: That truck is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.rate: Enter the rate as euros (0 or more), or leave it empty.
dispatch.error.customerMismatch: The customer does not match the selected order. Reload the page and pick the order again.
dispatch.error.invalidInput: The server rejected a field: {detail}. Fix it and try again.
dispatch.error.orderNotFound: That order no longer exists in your company. Refresh the list and pick another.
dispatch.error.driverNotFound: That driver no longer exists in your company. Pick another.
dispatch.error.truckNotFound: That truck no longer exists in your company. Pick another.
error.invalidCredentials: That email and password did not match. Check both and try again.
error.accountLocked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Ask your fleet owner to unlock it, or try again in 15 minutes.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
error.forbidden: Your role does not have access to this. Ask your fleet owner if you need it.
error.noOrg: This account is not attached to a company. Ask your fleet owner to finish the setup.
error.badRequest: Something in the request was not valid. Check the fields and try again.
error.requiredFields: Enter your email and password to sign in.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your fleet owner.
error.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
error.notFoundBody: That page does not exist in the app. Use the navigation to pick a screen.
error.loadFailed: Could not load your session. Try again.
trips.filterBadRange: The "from" date is after the "to" date. Adjust the range and try again.
trips.filterInvalid: The server rejected the filter "{field}". Adjust it and try again.
trips.empty: No trips yet. Create one from Dispatch.
trips.emptyFiltered: No trips match these filters. Widen or reset them.
trips.noDocuments: No documents uploaded for this trip.
trips.noExpenses: No expenses recorded for this trip.
